messages.content: 紐約目前的交通狀況如何？

function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.content: 抱歉，我無法即時取得紐約市的實時交通資訊。建議您使用像 Google 地圖、Waze 或當地交通局網站（如 NYC DOT）來查看最新的道路擁堵、事故或公共交通延誤情況。若您需要協助查找特定路段或地址，請告訴我！
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "紐約目前的交通狀況如何？" meaning "What is the current traffic situation in New York?" We need to provide an answer. The user wants real-time traffic data. We have no direct access to live traffic data. We can respond that we don't have real-time data. But we could suggest using Google Maps or Waze. We might also ask if they want a specific area. But the instruction says we should not fabricate. So we should say we cannot provide real-time traffic. Possibly we can use geocode_address? No, that's for addresses. There's no tool for traffic. So we should respond that we can't provide real-time traffic.
